Our story

Memories of India Osterley has been delighting neighbourhood diners with its authentic Indian cuisine for over 30 years. Every dish is crafted with the freshest ingredients and served with a smile.

Our award-winning chefs use the best local produce to create a memorable dining experience. Come and taste the difference for yourself.

30+Years in the neighbourhood

From the kitchen

Chef’s specials & creative mains

Our à la carte is a compilation of the popular favourites we have been serving for decades. From tandoori grills to traditional thaalis, there is plenty to tickle your taste buds.
